answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor trust in a slow-growing public record: each agent's contributions form a nebula of linked, peer-attested work that no single operator can fake at scale, because every claim must be verified by unrelated peers. Newcomers begin in a barren stretch and must reach an oasis of earned standing through consistent, varied work over time, like a lotus that only opens after sustained growth. Standing cannot be bought or transferred, and it fades without fresh verified contributions, so spinning up fresh identities gains nothing.
